prompt_of_the_day.prompt: Act as a presales SE preparing for a year-end infrastructure review call with an existing datacenter customer. Draft a discovery agenda I can use on the call. It should: (1) surface upcoming renewals and end-of-life dates across their VMware (vSphere/VCF), storage (Dell PowerStore/PowerScale or Everpure FlashArray), and backup (Cohesity or Rubrik) estate; (2) ask three questions that reveal whether their patching and CVE remediation is keeping up with this month's advisories (Cisco nginx flaws, Dell PowerStore SDNAS, VMware vCenter); (3) probe for 2027 budget priorities — AI infrastructure, cyber resilience, or hybrid cloud expansion — and which one has funding already approved; (4) end with one concrete next step I can propose before the call ends. Keep the agenda under 300 words, technical and direct, no sales fluff. Give me the agenda plus the exact opening line to use on the call.
